dispositions.topic_text: Outcome and call prevention when the owner refuses add-room approval
dispositions.reason: What a run, its node and the agent receive when the owner refuses, cancels or lets an approval lapse, and that the operation is then not called, are Kernel's (case cabinet-kernel, K-08, K-09): a refused effect ends the run refused and the call is not sent. Registry receives either the approved call or none, and its flows are the same either way (as State 4 round-57 T3).

dispositions.topic_text: Add-room approval gate, responsible capability, actor, and request binding
dispositions.reason: Owner, 2026-11-23: a request that names no project means the session's active project when Registry applies it (R0-46, R0-69; State 4 stage (2) through check_agent_call), and the owner sees at approval that no project is named. Only the owner changes the active project (R0-32, R0-70), so a room landing in a newly made active project follows the owner's own act between approval and call. How Kernel ties an approval to a request and checks a standing approval is Kernel's (K-08). Registry's behaviour stays as stated.
